name: The version fault line
reader_question: What may change, and where does the evidence stop?
visual_idea: A full-height version seam separates a pinned historical record from an open evidence requirement; no arrow completes the gap.
why_geometry_helps: A full-height version seam separates a pinned historical record from an open evidence requirement; no arrow completes the gap.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: The left evidence could be mistaken for a prior pass; the record prominently states no observed result, not merely historical.
references_used: Supplied Design Board-8: simultaneous source, interpretation and responsibility
Supplied Design System-15: material distinction, authored scale and quiet chrome
what_is_deliberately_not_shown: Detailed chapter text and actual enterprise readiness.
